fixture.price_disclaimer: XAU/XAG reference prices in this fixture are SYNTHETIC test values, not market quotes. Research context: gold traded around US$3,986-4,073/oz at end-June 2026. The fixture marks origination at US$4,200/oz for round arithmetic.

ccr_threshold_ladder.note: Gold price at which CCR touches each monitoring threshold, holding quantity at 5,200 dmt, senior outstanding at 5,200,000 and silver at the origination mark. Fixed TC/RC/penalties/realisation do not scale with price, so collateral value is geared to gold.
ccr_threshold_ladder.elasticity_reading: a 1% fall in gold takes about 1.144% off collateral value

pricing.note: Two independent price tracks. Confusing them is the single easiest way to get this product wrong.

contract_price.what_it_determines: Every dollar the offtaker pays: originalOfftakerPrice at mint, and offtakerAmount at each recordPayment.
contract_price.source: LBMA Gold Price PM (USD) and LBMA Silver Price, per offtake clause 10.1
contract_price.mechanism: Quotational period. Not the trade date, not spot
contract_price.provisional_rule: 5-day average to the B/L date, offtake clause 10.3
contract_price.final_rule: arithmetic average of all fixings in the QP month, offtake clause 10.2
contract_price.quotational_period: 2 MAMA, second calendar month after month of arrival
contract_price.is_this_normal: Yes. Universal in concentrate trade. AusIMM Monograph 20 worked example uses 2 MAMA with 85-90% provisional; the Global Gold / Mego SEC-filed gold-concentrate contract prices the same way; Fastmarkets reports QPs lengthening to M+4/M+5 as gold rose.
contract_price.once_fixed: immutable. A later market move does not change what the buyer owes

market_price.what_it_determines: Live collateral value, therefore CCR, therefore watchlist and margin calls. Never a settlement figure.
market_price.source: Chainlink XAU/USD read off-chain, Pyth Hermes cross-check, MetalpriceAPI second opinion
market_price.on_chain_write: Trustee writes ccrBps only on a threshold crossing, not per tick

pricing.why_they_diverge: Between B/L and QP fixing the borrower is short the gold price on the unpaid portion. At the 2026-10-15 trough the market marked collateral at 3690.00 while the Lot A contract price was already locked at 4240.00. CCR broke 130% on a receivable that had stopped moving. That is the loan's real risk, and it is only visible because the two tracks are kept separate.

collateral_basis_transition.before_qp_fixing: collateral is GOODS. Value = NSR at the live market price, less realisation, less haircut. Fully price-exposed.
collateral_basis_transition.after_qp_fixing: collateral is a FIXED-DOLLAR RECEIVABLE from the smelter. Commodity risk is gone; what remains is offtaker credit risk. Marking it to live gold after this point is wrong.
collateral_basis_transition.status_in_this_fixture: Not reached. Senior is retired on 2026-12-28, three days before the Lot A QP closes, so the whole loan lives in the goods-marked-to-market regime.
collateral_basis_transition.spec_gap: collateral-valuation.md has one reference_price and no basis flag, so the relayer would keep marking a fixed receivable to live gold on any deal whose senior outlives the QP fixing. Needs a collateral_basis field on the valuation record.

market_mark_series.note: Live market marks driving CCR. These are NOT the settlement prices. Drive the price feed through this series and the notification stream should reproduce the threshold_crossings column exactly.

realisation_costs.stored_as: one scalar on the offtake row
realisation_costs.warning: The implementation treats this as a FIXED dollar amount. This fixture derives it from freight + insurance(0.09% of gross) + superintendence + marketing(1.5% of NSR), two of which move with price. At the 3,690 trough the derived figure is 518,518.44 against the stored 547,299.81, so CCR reads 127.43% here and 127.10% from the API. Both cross 130%; the gap is 0.33pp and grows as price falls further.

single_reference_price_gap.what: compute_collateral applies ONE reference price to every payable metal. This fixture has gold at 4,200.00 and silver at 50.00.
single_reference_price_gap.impact: Silver is priced at the gold price: gross silver becomes 4,002,379.08 instead of 47,647.37. CCR reads 193.62% instead of 147.98% — 45.64 percentage points too high, in the safe-looking direction.

gold_only_variant.note: safe to run against the current implementation with no price-feed change

priority_order.spec_and_this_fixture: senior principal -> mgmt -> coupon -> perf -> OET -> residual
priority_order.implementation: interest tier (coupon+mgmt+perf, proportional) -> OET -> senior principal -> equity
priority_order.impact: At P1 the endpoint returns senior_principal_returned = 5,200,000.00, retiring the whole tranche in one payment, not this fixture's 2,600,000.00 scheduled amortisation. The fixture's schedule is a Trustee OVERRIDE and will be flagged as a deviation.

interest_basis.note: compound reads about 4-6% LOWER than simple over these tenors

equity_is_uncapped.implementation: equity_distributed is the final uncapped residual
equity_is_uncapped.impact: The endpoint would return equity_distributed = 696,325.95 at P1 and 6,194,113.55 at P2. Cumulative equityDistributed then vastly exceeds originalEquityTranche, so the close-time invariant equityDistributed == originalEquityTranche does NOT hold against the implementation.

p3_is_rejected.what: compute_waterfall rejects amount > original_offtaker_price - offtaker_received with HTTP 400, on the stated reasoning that 'nothing legitimate can cause the offtaker to pay more than the contracted price'.
p3_is_rejected.why_that_is_false_here: A quotational-period-priced concentrate settles on a metal average that is unknown at mint. Gold rose over the QP, so the contracted total was exceeded by 5.00% through no fault of any party.
p3_is_rejected.consequence: the final settlement of a rising-price concentrate deal cannot be recorded

soroban_contract_divergences.no_matured_status: LoanStatus has 4 variants: Performing, WatchList, Default, Closed. There is no Matured. 'Past Due' is DERIVED server-side from current_maturity_timestamp < now. The runbook step that sets status Matured has no on-chain call.
soroban_contract_divergences.no_maturity_cap_on_accrual: last_epoch_interest_factor uses timestamp - effective_from with no min() against maturity_date, so interest accrues past maturity on chain. The API's piecewise_capped_seconds DOES cap. Contract and API disagree.
soroban_contract_divergences.epoch_appended_on_every_payment: record_payment calls append_economics_epoch to capitalize accrued interest. After 3 payments the epoch array has 4 rows, not 1.
soroban_contract_divergences.loan_nft_is_soulbound: transfer, transfer_from, approve and approve_for_all all panic

implementation_bugs_found.what: rejects a legitimate QP-repriced final settlement with HTTP 400
implementation_bugs_found.fix: allow an overage tolerance, or gate the check on a pricing_basis flag

implementation_bugs_found.what: one reference price applied to every payable metal
implementation_bugs_found.fix: per-metal price feed; until then restrict to single-metal concentrates

implementation_bugs_found.what: payable_grade = grade*pct - min_deduction is not floored at zero, so a metal below its minimum deduction SUBTRACTS value. Silver at 35 g/dmt gives -0.25 g/t, -41.7959 payable oz, and -175,542.95 off the NSR.
implementation_bugs_found.fix: clamp payable_grade at zero, matching the physical contract

implementation_bugs_found.what: no maturity cap on accrual; contract disagrees with the API and both specs

documents.note: Mock trade and security documents. Each cid is a genuine CIDv1 (raw codec 0x55, sha2-256, base32) over the file bytes, so the hash chain is verifiable even though the content is synthetic.

publication_policy.on_ipfs: metadata.json only. It carries titles, stages and sha256 digests.
publication_policy.document_bodies: Held in the private document store. IPFS is public and permanent, and 9 of the 21 documents carry personal data, bank details or commercial terms that cannot be unpublished. collateral-valuation.md permits 'the assay certificate and the offtake extract, OR THEIR HASHES'.

stages.post: arises after shipment. Appended to the record, gates nothing
